# RULE R4: method phrases ("by ELISA", "(Method: X)") are stripped from the name; the administrative-word guard
# applies only to lines with no qualitative result and no known analyte; a result is never silently dropped.

HBsAg by CLIA Reactive
=> HBsAg | POSITIVE
=> risk>=high

eGFR by MDRD 12 mL/min/1.73m2 >=60

Hemoglobin (Method: Cyanmethemoglobin) 6.9 g/dL 13.0-17.0

@@ R4 | M | 40 | name with by inside a known analyte
Potassium by Indirect ISE 6.8 mmol/L 3.5-5.1
=> Potassium | CRITICAL_HIGH | 6.8
@@ R4 | M | 40 | serology on a line together with a numeric result
HBsAg by ELISA Reactive   Hemoglobin 14.1 g/dL 13.0-17.0
=> HBsAg | POSITIVE
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 14.1
@@ R4 | M | 40 | a result with a unit but an unknown name is kept as UNKNOWN with a warning
Hemoglobin 14.1 g/dL 13.0-17.0
Status Zorbulin 55 U/L
=> Hemoglobin | NORMAL | 14.1
=> Status Zorbulin | UNKNOWN | 55
=> warn
=> risk=unknown
